prompt_en: An unmistakably adult woman is photographed in Y2K pop-sport street fashion around 2000 at a civic fountain plaza beside temporary festival stalls. In a pickup game on a marked pop-up court, she has just secured a basketball rebound beneath a portable hoop. Both hands clasp opposite sides of the ball at chest height; her elbows bend naturally in front of her torso. Her feet land shoulder-width apart on the dry paving, with both knees flexed and the ball held within her own arm span. She wears a cropped baby tee with a white body and sky-blue raglan sleeves, low-rise roomy nylon track pants in cobalt with white side piping, and chunky platform sneakers. A thin silver hip chain hangs against the waistband, and slim tinted wraparound sunglasses sit on top of her dark chin-length bob with separated fringe. Her visible appearance follows the reference image's dark eyes, softly defined eyelids, light skin and softly colored lips. A gust has lifted several paper music flyers from an open crate on a parked portable speaker cart beside the court; the cart also holds a silver portable CD player with its transparent disc lid visible. An adult stall attendant reaches toward the floating flyers while the player glances across the ball toward this disturbance. Fountain jets and fabric stall canopies establish the open public space behind them. Use a low three-quarter full-body photograph from just beyond the main path, showing her face, waistband, both hands, the ball and both sneakers clearly. Clear late-afternoon sunshine gives the nylon folds crisp highlights, and wind lifts the tee hem and loose fringe while the court, hoop, cart and airborne paper remain spatially legible. Position the cart near the foreground edge, with the landing player in the middle distance and the fountain stalls farther back, preserving a clear corridor around both grasping hands and the ball. A pale flicker from the fountain travels across the hip chain and the clear CD lid.
